data.exact_reserve_text: Due, however, to the uncertainty inherent in the claims estimation process, initial reserves may not always be in a surplus. In 2018, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 5.0m on prior year reserves (2017 deficit of GBP 4.9m). The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 152.455m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 15.45m (gross), driven primarily by reserve increases in the Marine and Energy classes. The report also notes a net (after reinsurance) prior year deficit of GBP 5.0m, reflecting the effect of reinsurance; the syndicate highlights premium reductions and reserve increases on marine and energy as the primary drivers of the adverse movement.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Technical Provisions (gross claims outstanding) explicit table. Gross prior-year development computed from the gross claims development (triangle) by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years <= 2016, yielding a gross adverse movement of ~GBP 15.449m (confidence 0.8). The report also states a net prior year deficit of GBP 5.0m (explicitly stated) which is net of reinsurance; no explicit gross movement figure is given in narrative. LOB-specific amounts for the PYD are not quantified in the report, only referenced qualitatively (marine and energy). All top-level monetary amounts are presented in millions (rounded to three decimals).
